summary: After the Solid 2 migration, Storybook kept the framework preset's own Solid compiler (registered as a nested plugin array the filter never matched) beside the Lingui-aware one. The preset compiled every `<Trans>` before the Lingui macro ran, the macro then removed its import, and screen stories failed to render with `Trans is not defined`. Register the Lingui-aware compiler in the base Vite config so the framework recognizes it before choosing its compiler.
